# inkscape-mcp — full manifest (llms-full.txt)

inkscape-mcp — an MCP server that makes Inkscape/SVG documents agent-ready: inspect, edit safely (reversible), validate, render, and export.

Surface: 10 tools, 7 prompts, 17 resources.

## Run & transport
Transport: STDIO only (local). No HTTP.
Run: uv run inkscape-mcp
Console script: inkscape-mcp = inkscape_mcp.server:main

## Environment / configuration
Workspace roots (required): INKSCAPE_MCP_WORKSPACE_ROOTS (OS-path-separator-delimited list of allowed dirs; the sandbox boundary).
Operator-tunable limits / gates (all optional, env-overridable):
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_ACTION_ALLOWLIST
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_ARTIFACT_KEEP_DAYS
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES_PER_DOC
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_EDIT_PREVIEWS
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_ENGINE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_S
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_ENGINE_MAX_PROCESSES
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_ENGINE_MODE
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_EXTENSION_ALLOWLIST
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_LIVE_CACHE_MAX_BYTES
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_LIVE_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_LIVE_COALESCE_BUDGET_MS
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_LIVE_ENABLED
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_LIVE_FRAME_KEEP_DAYS
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_LIVE_FRAME_MAX_BYTES
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_MAX_EXPORT_PX
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_MAX_INPUT_BYTES
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_MAX_PROCS
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_PROCESS_TIMEOUT_S
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_RAW_ACTION_ENABLED
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_SNAPSHOT_HARD_MAX_BYTES
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_SNAPSHOT_HARD_MAX_N
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_SNAPSHOT_KEEP_DAYS
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_SNAPSHOT_KEEP_N

## Tools

### Author

#### edit
Risk class: high
Key params: doc_id: string, ops: array, render: string, dry_run: boolean, detail: string, approval_token: ['string', 'null']
Description:
    Change a document with typed ops in ONE atomic call (all or nothing, one snapshot; undo with history): create shapes, restyle, move, group, text, compose, optimize. Refer to an op's new object as '$<op index>'; target existing ones with ids=[...] or select={tag,fill,...}. render='inline' returns a PNG; dry_run=true the plan. HIGH ops (delete, set_svg, insert_svg, path ops) need approval_token. help(op=NAME) shows fields. Example: edit(doc_id, ops=[{'op':'create_rect','x':0,'y':0,'width':200,'height':100,'fill':'#36f','id':'bg'},{'op':'fill','ids':['$0'],'color':'#f63'}], render='inline')

#### open
Risk class: medium
Key params: path: ['string', 'null'], svg: ['string', 'null'], canvas: object | null, from_live: object | null, ops: ['array', 'null'], render: string, detail: string, approval_token: ['string', 'null']
Description:
    Start working: returns a doc_id. Give exactly ONE source: path (existing SVG in the workspace), svg (SVG text), canvas {width,height,viewBox?,background?} (blank page) or from_live {dest_path} (save the live Inkscape canvas into the workspace). Optional `ops` run the first edit in the same call (same format as edit); render='inline' returns a PNG (of the opened page when there are no ops). Example: open(canvas={'width':800,'height':600,'background':'#fff'}, ops=[{'op':'create_circle','cx':400,'cy':300,'r':100,'fill':'#f63'}], render='inline')

### Inspect

#### inspect
Risk class: low
Key params: doc_id: string | array, include: ['array', 'null'], select: object | null, detail: string, limit: integer, series: ['string', 'null']
Description:
    Read-only view of one document (or several: pass a list of doc_ids). `include` picks sections: summary (default), objects, tree, layers, styles, fonts, assets, validate, quality, snapshots, frames. `select` filters `objects` (tag, fill, stroke, text, id_prefix, bbox) so you need no separate find call; giving only `select` returns just the objects, as [id, tag, bbox, fill] rows capped by `limit` (truncated=true when cut). detail: ids | summary | full. Example: inspect(doc_id, select={'tag': 'rect'})

#### render
Risk class: low
Key params: doc_id: string, target: string, object_id: ['string', 'null'], width_px: ['integer', 'null'], series: ['string', 'null'], label: ['string', 'null']
Description:
    Render the document as a PNG you can see inline. target='page' (default): the whole page; 'object': one object clipped to its box (needs object_id); 'frame': the next numbered frame of a `series` (a screenshot log; optional `label`). width_px sets the raster width. Use it after edits to check the result (edit(render='inline') already includes one render). Example: render(doc_id, target='object', object_id='logo', width_px=512)

### Export

#### export
Risk class: high
Key params: doc_id: string | array, targets: array, out_dir: ['string', 'null'], name_prefix: ['string', 'null'], byte_budget: ['integer', 'null'], dry_run: boolean, approval_token: ['string', 'null']
Description:
    Write results to files in the workspace. `targets` is a list of: {kind:'file', format:'png|pdf|svg', object_id?, width_px?}, {kind:'profile', name:'web|icons|print', ...} or {kind:'save_as', dest_path, overwrite?}. doc_id may be a list to export a set (files are prefixed with each doc_id). dry_run=true plans and projects sizes without writing; byte_budget caps the total. Returns each artifact's workspace path, size and pixel dimensions. Example: export(doc_id, targets=[{'kind':'file','format':'png','width_px':1024},{'kind':'file','format':'svg'}])

### History

#### history
Risk class: medium
Key params: doc_id: string, action: string, snapshot_id: ['string', 'null'], label: ['string', 'null']
Description:
    Undo/redo safety net. Every edit already writes one snapshot. action='list' shows them; 'create' checkpoints now (optional label); 'restore' rolls the working copy back to `snapshot_id` (itself reversible: it snapshots first); 'prune' reclaims old snapshots and live frames; 'reload' re-reads the source file under the same doc_id (pre-reload snapshot taken). Example: history(doc_id, action='restore', snapshot_id='snap-0003')

### Live

#### live
Risk class: medium
Key params: action: string, prefer: string, include: ['array', 'null'], region: object | null, scale: ['number', 'null'], fast: boolean, timeout_s: number, poll_interval_s: number, mode: ['string', 'null'], zoom: ['number', 'null'], center_x: ['number', 'null'], center_y: ['number', 'null'], dx: ['number', 'null'], dy: ['number', 'null'], operation_id: ['string', 'null']
Description:
    Look at (and steer the view of) a running Inkscape. action='observe' with include=[document, selection, inspect, scene, view] returns those parts in one call ('view' is an inline PNG of the canvas; region/scale/fast shape it); 'wait' blocks until something changes; 'viewport' (mode, zoom, center_x/y, dx/dy) moves the view; 'diff' (operation_id) shows what a live_edit changed; 'export_selection' renders the selection. Setup: check, connect, disconnect, status, install_helper, arm_socket. Connects automatically. Example: live(action='observe', include=['selection','inspect','view'], fast=true)

#### live_edit
Risk class: high
Key params: action: string, style: object | null, transform: object | null, svg_fragment: ['string', 'null'], text: ['string', 'null'], observe: string, approval_token: ['string', 'null']
Description:
    Change the live Inkscape selection. action='apply' with style {fill, stroke, stroke_width, opacity} and/or transform {dx, dy, scale, rotate}; 'insert_svg' with svg_fragment; 'set_text' with text. observe='render' returns an inline PNG of the canvas afterwards, 'diff' a before/after overlay, 'none' just the result. Always HIGH risk: needs approval_token. Connects automatically. Example: live_edit(action='apply', style={'fill':'#f63'}, observe='render', approval_token='ok')

### Advanced

#### actions
Risk class: high
Key params: action: string, steps: ['array', 'null'], doc_id: ['string', 'null'], all: boolean, dry_run: ['boolean', 'null'], approval_token: ['string', 'null']
Description:
    Advanced escape hatch: allowlisted Inkscape Actions. action='list' shows what this runtime exposes (all=false omits the id array), 'extensions' the allowlisted extensions, 'validate' checks `steps` [{action, args[]}] without running, 'run' executes the chain on doc_id, 'raw' runs ONE step (dry_run defaults to true). Running is HIGH risk: needs approval_token. Prefer edit ops when one exists. Example: actions(action='run', doc_id=d, steps=[{'action':'select-all'}], approval_token='ok')

### Help

#### help
Risk class: low
Key params: goal: ['string', 'null'], op: ['string', 'null'], topic: ['string', 'null'], stat_paths: ['array', 'null']
Description:
    Ask for guidance. goal='make the svg smaller' -> the tool:op to use + an example call; op='fill' -> that edit op's fields, risk and a valid example; topic='ops' lists every op, 'capabilities' shows what this runtime supports, 'diagnose' re-probes it; stat_paths=[...] returns size + sha256 of workspace files. No arguments: the short workflow. Example: help(op='create_rect')

## Edit ops

ops that act on objects take ids=[...] or select={tag,fill,stroke,text,id_prefix,bbox}; '$<n>' names the id op n created.
help(op=NAME) gives fields and an example.

### create

#### create_rect
Risk: medium · creates an id
Does: Create a `<rect>`.
Fields: id: str | None?, parent: str | None?, x: float, y: float, width: float, height: float, rx: float | None?, ry: float | None?, fill: str | None?, stroke: str | None?, stroke_width: str | None?
Example: {"op":"create_rect","x":0,"y":0,"width":200,"height":100,"fill":"#3366ff","id":"bg"}

#### create_circle
Risk: medium · creates an id
Does: Create a `<circle>`.
Fields: id: str | None?, parent: str | None?, cx: float, cy: float, r: float, fill: str | None?, stroke: str | None?, stroke_width: str | None?
Example: {"op":"create_circle","cx":50,"cy":50,"r":40,"fill":"#ffcc00"}

#### create_ellipse
Risk: medium · creates an id
Does: Create an `<ellipse>`.
Fields: id: str | None?, parent: str | None?, cx: float, cy: float, rx: float, ry: float, fill: str | None?, stroke: str | None?, stroke_width: str | None?
Example: {"op":"create_ellipse","cx":50,"cy":50,"rx":40,"ry":20}

#### create_line
Risk: medium · creates an id
Does: Create a `<line>`.
Fields: id: str | None?, parent: str | None?, x1: float, y1: float, x2: float, y2: float, stroke: str | None?, stroke_width: str | None?
Example: {"op":"create_line","x1":0,"y1":0,"x2":100,"y2":100,"stroke":"#000000","stroke_width":"2"}

#### create_polygon
Risk: medium · creates an id
Does: Create a closed `<polygon>` from `[x, y]` points.
Fields: id: str | None?, parent: str | None?, points: list[tuple[float, float]], fill: str | None?, stroke: str | None?, stroke_width: str | None?
Example: {"op":"create_polygon","points":[[0,0],[100,0],[50,80]],"fill":"#cc3333"}

#### create_polyline
Risk: medium · creates an id
Does: Create an open `<polyline>` from `[x, y]` points.
Fields: id: str | None?, parent: str | None?, points: list[tuple[float, float]], fill: str | None?, stroke: str | None?, stroke_width: str | None?
Example: {"op":"create_polyline","points":[[0,0],[50,40],[100,0]],"stroke":"#000000"}

#### create_path
Risk: medium · creates an id
Does: Create a `<path>` from path data `d`.
Fields: id: str | None?, parent: str | None?, d: str, fill: str | None?, stroke: str | None?, stroke_width: str | None?
Example: {"op":"create_path","d":"M10 10 L90 10 L50 80 Z","fill":"#228833"}

#### create_text
Risk: medium · creates an id
Does: Create a `<text>` at `(x, y)`; `anchor='middle'` centres it on `x`.
Fields: id: str | None?, parent: str | None?, x: float, y: float, text: str, fill: str | None?, stroke: str | None?, stroke_width: str | None?, anchor: Optional[Literal['start', 'middle', 'end']]?
Example: {"op":"create_text","x":100,"y":60,"text":"Hello","fill":"#222222","anchor":"middle"}

#### create_group
Risk: medium · creates an id
Does: Create an empty `<g>`.
Fields: id: str | None?, parent: str | None?
Example: {"op":"create_group","id":"logo"}

#### create_use
Risk: medium · creates an id
Does: Create a `<use>` instance of the existing object `href`.
Fields: id: str | None?, parent: str | None?, href: str, x: float | None?, y: float | None?, transform: str | None?
Example: {"op":"create_use","href":"bg","x":10,"y":10}

#### linear_gradient
Risk: medium · creates an id
Does: Add a `<linearGradient>` to `<defs>`; use it as `url(#id)` or `url(#$n)` in a later paint.
Fields: stops: list[Stop], x1: str?, y1: str?, x2: str?, y2: str?, id: str | None?
Example: {"op":"linear_gradient","id":"sky","stops":[{"offset":0,"color":"#ffffff"},{"offset":1,"color":"#3366ff"}]}

#### radial_gradient
Risk: medium · creates an id
Does: Add a `<radialGradient>` to `<defs>`; use it as `url(#id)` or `url(#$n)` in a later paint.
Fields: stops: list[Stop], cx: str?, cy: str?, r: str?, fx: str | None?, fy: str | None?, id: str | None?
Example: {"op":"radial_gradient","id":"glow","stops":[{"offset":0,"color":"#ffff00"},{"offset":1,"color":"#ff8800"}]}

#### group
Risk: medium · creates an id
Does: Wrap the targets in a new `<g>` (the new group's id is `id`, or minted).
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?, id: str | None?
Example: {"op":"group","ids":["a","b"],"id":"pair"}

#### reparent
Risk: medium
Does: Move each target under the existing object `parent` (appended last, so painted on top).
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?, parent: str
Example: {"op":"reparent","ids":["a"],"parent":"pair"}

### style

#### fill
Risk: medium
Does: Set the fill colour (or `url(#id)`) of the targets, optionally with a fill opacity.
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?, color: str, opacity: float | None?
Example: {"op":"fill","ids":["bg"],"color":"#ff0000"}

#### stroke
Risk: medium
Does: Set stroke colour / width / opacity of the targets (at least one of the three).
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?, color: str | None?, width: str | None?, opacity: float | None?
Example: {"op":"stroke","ids":["bg"],"color":"#000000","width":"2"}

#### opacity
Risk: medium
Does: Set the element-level opacity (0..1) of the targets.
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?, opacity: float
Example: {"op":"opacity","ids":["bg"],"opacity":0.5}

#### replace_color
Risk: medium
Does: Replace colour `from_color` by `to_color` document-wide, or within `ids` / `select`.
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?, from_color: str, to_color: str
Example: {"op":"replace_color","from_color":"#ff0000","to_color":"#00aa00"}

#### palette
Risk: medium
Does: Apply many colour replacements (`mapping` old -> new), document-wide or within a scope.
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?, mapping: dict[str, str]
Example: {"op":"palette","mapping":{"#ff0000":"#00aa00","#0000ff":"#222222"}}

#### font
Risk: medium
Does: Set font family / size / weight (at least one) on text targets.
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?, family: str | None?, size: str | None?, weight: str | None?
Example: {"op":"font","select":{"tag":"text"},"family":"DejaVu Sans","size":"24"}

Example: {"op":"replace_text","ids":["title"],"text":"New title"}

#### duplicate
Risk: medium · creates an id
Does: Duplicate each target in place (clone stacked just above). `new_id` needs one target.
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?, new_id: str | None?
Example: {"op":"duplicate","ids":["bg"],"new_id":"bg2"}

#### rename
Risk: medium
Does: Change the id and/or label of one target; references to the old id are rewritten.
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?, new_id: str | None?, label: str | None?
Example: {"op":"rename","ids":["bg"],"new_id":"background","label":"Background"}

#### delete
Risk: high · needs approval_token
Does: Delete the targets (HIGH risk: needs an `approval_token`).
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?
Example: {"op":"delete","ids":["bg"]}

### transform

#### move
Risk: medium
Does: Translate each target by `(dx, dy)` (each defaults to 0).
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?, dx: float?, dy: float?
Example: {"op":"move","ids":["bg"],"dx":10,"dy":-5}

#### scale
Risk: medium
Does: Scale each target by `sx` (and `sy`, default `sx`) about its own centre.
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?, sx: float, sy: float | None?
Example: {"op":"scale","ids":["bg"],"sx":1.5}

#### rotate
Risk: medium
Does: Rotate each target by `degrees` about its centre (or about `(cx, cy)` when both given).
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?, degrees: float, cx: float | None?, cy: float | None?
Example: {"op":"rotate","ids":["bg"],"degrees":45}

#### tile
Risk: medium · creates an id
Does: Lay out a `rows` x `cols` grid of clones of each target, `dx` / `dy` apart.
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?, rows: int, cols: int, dx: float, dy: float
Example: {"op":"tile","ids":["bg"],"rows":2,"cols":3,"dx":120,"dy":120}

#### resize_canvas
Risk: medium
Does: Set the canvas width/height (optionally adjusting the viewBox, or adding a bleed).
Fields: width: str, height: str, adjust_viewbox: bool?, bleed: float | None?, bleed_color: str?
Example: {"op":"resize_canvas","width":"400","height":"300"}

#### normalize_viewbox

Fields: 
Example: {"op":"normalize_viewbox"}

#### fit_to_content
Risk: medium
Does: Set the root viewBox to the content bounding box (measured by Inkscape).
Fields: 
Example: {"op":"fit_to_content"}

### compose

#### set_svg
Risk: high · needs approval_token
Does: REPLACE the whole document with `svg` (root `<svg>`, allowlist-scrubbed). HIGH risk.
Fields: svg: str
Example: {"op":"set_svg","svg":"<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"10\" height=\"10\"/>"}

#### insert_svg
Risk: high · needs approval_token · creates an id
Does: Graft an SVG fragment under `parent` (default: the root; allowlist-scrubbed). HIGH risk.
Fields: svg: str, parent: str | None?, unwrap: bool?
Example: {"op":"insert_svg","svg":"<circle xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" cx=\"5\" cy=\"5\" r=\"4\"/>"}

#### place
Risk: medium · creates an id
Does: Place another document (or one of its objects) here at `(x, y)` scaled by `scale`. A same-document source is read from the CURRENT in-memory state; another document is read from its saved working copy. The placed content is wrapped in a new `<g>` (the created id).
Fields: source_doc_id: str, source_id: str | None?, x: float, y: float, scale: float?
Example: {"op":"place","source_doc_id":"doc-other","x":10,"y":10,"scale":0.5}

#### grid
Risk: medium · creates an id
Does: Lay documents (`doc_ids`) or objects of one document (`source_doc_id` + `source_ids`) out in a `rows` x `cols` grid of `cell`-sized cells in THIS document (sources are read from their saved working copies).
Fields: rows: int, cols: int, cell: float, doc_ids: list[str] | None?, source_doc_id: str | None?, source_ids: list[str] | None?, gap: float?, scale_to_fit: bool?, padding: float?
Example: {"op":"grid","doc_ids":["doc-a","doc-b"],"rows":1,"cols":2,"cell":128}

### path

#### simplify
Risk: high · needs approval_token
Does: Simplify the targeted paths (fewer nodes; lossy).
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?
Example: {"op":"simplify","ids":["p1"]}

#### union
Risk: high · needs approval_token · creates an id
Does: Boolean union of >= 2 targets into one path (the bottom-most id survives).
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?
Example: {"op":"union","ids":["p1","p2"]}

#### difference
Risk: high · needs approval_token · creates an id
Does: Boolean difference: the bottom-most target minus the others (its id survives).
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?
Example: {"op":"difference","ids":["p1","p2"]}

#### combine
Risk: high · needs approval_token · creates an id
Does: Combine >= 2 paths into one compound path (the bottom-most id survives).
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?
Example: {"op":"combine","ids":["p1","p2"]}

#### break_apart
Risk: high · needs approval_token
Does: Break compound paths into their sub-paths.
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?
Example: {"op":"break_apart","ids":["p1"]}

#### stroke_to_path
Risk: high · needs approval_token
Does: Convert strokes to filled outline paths.
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?
Example: {"op":"stroke_to_path","ids":["p1"]}

#### cleanup
Risk: high · needs approval_token
Does: Clean up the targeted paths (alias of simplify in Inkscape 1.4).
Fields: ids: list[str] | None?, select: Selector | None?
Example: {"op":"cleanup","ids":["p1"]}

### optimize

#### optimize_web
Risk: medium
Does: Web-optimize: strip editor data / unused defs, drop empty groups, round numbers. Ids, layers and layer locks are kept so the document stays editable; `aggressive=true` (HIGH risk, needs approval_token) also drops unreferenced ids, layers and namedview (the last step before shipping). Not a sanitizer: scripts and event attributes are left as they are.
Fields: precision: int?, keep_ids: list[str] | None?, aggressive: bool?
Example: {"op":"optimize_web","precision":3}


## Prompts

#### compose_artwork
Args: goal
Description: On-ramp the generative loop: open → edit(render='inline') → look → export.

Orients the agent to build new artwork toward `goal` from a blank canvas with typed `edit` ops,
look at the inline picture, validate, then export. Guidance only — it executes nothing and
adds no authority; the work flows through the gated tools it names.

#### live_canvas_assist
Args: goal
Description: Entry point for the live-view co-pilot loop: perceive→decide→act→observe (approval-gated).

Orients the agent to drive a running Inkscape via the live tools toward `goal`, one bounded,
cancelable iteration at a time. Acts are semantic-only and approval-gated; the loop adds no new
authority.

#### prepare_icon_set
Args: (none)
Description: Orient the agent on producing a multi-size square PNG icon set.

#### prepare_print_export
Args: (none)
Description: Orient the agent on exporting a print-ready vector PDF.

#### prepare_web_export
Args: (none)
Description: Orient the agent on exporting a document as web-ready assets (PNG + plain SVG).

#### restyle_artwork
Args: goal
Description: On-ramp the OBJECT-TARGETED restyle loop: select → fill/stroke ops → render → export.

Orients the agent to restyle SPECIFIC objects toward `goal` — address them with `select`,
change each one's fill/stroke/opacity in one `edit` call, look, then export. This is the
per-object companion to the document-wide `theme_recoloring` prompt (which swaps colors across
the WHOLE document via `replace_color` / `palette`). Guidance only; adds no authority.

#### theme_recoloring
Args: (none)
Description: Orient the agent on recoloring a document to a brand/theme palette.

## Resources

#### inkscape://documents
Description: Index of open documents and their per-document resource URIs (discoverability).

The seven per-document resources above are registered as URI TEMPLATES (they carry a `{doc_id}`
placeholder), so they appear under `resources/templates/list` but NOT under the plain
`resources/list` that `ListMcpResourcesTool` reads — an agent could not otherwise discover the
concrete URIs for an opened document. This static (no-placeholder) resource closes that gap: it
lists every currently-open document id with the seven concrete `inkscape://document/<id>/<leaf>`
URIs for it, so the per-doc read surface is discoverable through `ListMcpResourcesTool`.

Host-path-free: only opaque document ids and their resource URIs are emitted — never a working
path. Risk class: low (read-only resource).

#### inkscape://live/events
Description: Latest live change state: the current cheap state token + classified deltas.

Polls the cheap state token once (a small revision marker + selection ids + coarse viewport —
never the full document or a PNG; protocol v5), hashes + diffs it against the session's last
seen token, and returns the classified `LiveChange` (`selection_changed` / `document_changed` /
`viewport_changed`, plus the new token). Surfaces the change stream so a host can poll the
canvas for deltas cheaply without busy-rendering. Returns an empty `LiveChange` when no live
session is connected or the transport cannot report a token (clean, not an error path).
READ-ONLY — no document mutation, no Operation Record.

Risk class: low (read-only perception).

#### inkscape://live/operations
Description: Recent Live Operation Records: what each live mutation changed and how.

Makes live mutations observable — each record carries the transport, selection, affected ids,
approval decision, before/after render paths, and status. Returns an empty log when there are
none or no workspace root is configured (never an error path).

Risk class: low (read-only).

#### inkscape://live/selection
Description: Current selection in the live instance (object ids).

Returns an empty selection when no live session is connected (clean, not an error path).

Risk class: low (read-only).

#### inkscape://live/session
Description: Current live-session state (enabled, connected, transport, available transports).

Returns a not-connected `LiveSession` when no session is up — never an error.

Risk class: low (read-only).

#### inkscape://live/view
Description: Current live frame's structured metadata: the `LiveScene`, without the PNG bytes.

Exposes the machine-readable scene — active-doc ref, selection ids + bboxes, viewport
(zoom/center/visible region), canvas size, and a compact visible-object summary (reusing the
headless object-inspection shape) — so a host can poll the canvas STRUCTURE, not pixels. Pulled
over the fixed `get_scene` transport command (no code path — ADR-003). Returns an empty
`LiveScene` when no live session is connected or the transport cannot report a scene (clean, not
an error path). READ-ONLY — no document mutation, no Operation Record.

Risk class: low (read-only perception).

#### inkscape://ops
Description: Reference for every `edit` / `open` op: group, fields, risk and a valid example.

The `edit` tool's schema does not carry the op union, so this resource (and `help(op=NAME)`)
is where an agent reads the exact fields of an op.

Risk class: low (read-only).

#### inkscape://prompts
Description: Index of registered MCP prompts (name + one-line purpose + arguments).

Makes the shipped prompt library (`live_canvas_assist`, the export/recolor library, the
authoring library) discoverable through the RESOURCE surface (`ListMcpResourcesTool`), which
otherwise cannot see prompts at all. Fetch a prompt's full text via the MCP prompts API
(`prompts/get`) using the name from this index.

Shape: ``{"prompt_count": N, "prompts": [{name, purpose, arguments: [{name, description,
required}]}, ...]}``. Sourced from the live registry (`mcp.list_prompts()`), so it cannot drift
from the registered prompts.

Risk class: low (read-only resource).

#### inkscape://runtime/capabilities
Description: Probed Inkscape/runtime capability matrix (version, actions, export formats, fonts, live).

Returns the same cached matrix as `help(topic='capabilities')`, including the authoritative
MCP tool surface (`tool_count` + `tools`, from the live registry). Use
`help(topic='diagnose')` to force a fresh probe.

Risk class: low (read-only).

#### inkscape://runtime/intents
Description: Curated natural-language goal → (tool, op) intent map, WITHOUT the full capabilities payload.

Shape: ``{"intents": [{goal_pattern, targets: [{tool, op}], how_to, group, example}, ...]}``.
This is the exact same curated map `help(goal=...)` matches against and the capabilities
`intents` section exposes — all derive from `inkscape_mcp.intents.intents_summary`, so they
cannot drift. Guidance only: it names which call achieves a goal and shows an example, and
executes nothing. Host-independent (not probed), so it needs no Inkscape binary.

Use this when you want just the discovery map without the heavier runtime probe matrix.

Risk class: low (read-only).

#### inkscape://document/{doc_id}/assets
Description: Referenced assets (images, uses, external url() refs) for one document.

Risk class: low (read-only resource).

#### inkscape://document/{doc_id}/fonts
Description: All font-family values (inline styles, `<style>` bodies, attrs) for one document.

Risk class: low (read-only resource).

#### inkscape://document/{doc_id}/layers
Description: All Inkscape layers (with visible/locked state) for one document.

Risk class: low (read-only resource).

#### inkscape://document/{doc_id}/objects
Description: Flattened object list for one document.

Risk class: low (read-only resource).

#### inkscape://document/{doc_id}/styles
Description: Distinct fill/stroke colors plus inline-style and CSS-rule counts for one document.

Risk class: low (read-only resource).

#### inkscape://document/{doc_id}/summary
Description: Document summary (size, units, viewBox, page/object/layer counts) for one document.

Risk class: low (read-only resource).

#### inkscape://document/{doc_id}/tree
Description: Full element tree (local tags + ids + inkscape:labels) for one document.

Risk class: low (read-only resource).
